metadata.title: When you get 2 kills and suddenly think you hacked the game... but nope
metadata.description:
Wait, I actually got 2 kills? Did I bribe the servers?
Watch me act like a pro while clearly faking it.
Valorant logic is wild enough to carry me.
Click if your luck is better than your aim!

Tap if luck once made you look like a pro!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckygamer #funnyclips #shorts
